_: ق-249 — routes inside a service's domain that carry NO capability gate, each with the reason.
This list only shrinks: capability-registry.guard.mjs fails when a route here gains its gate
(delete the row) and when a new domain route appears in neither list.
Principle: the gate sits on the action that creates or changes state under a capability, and
on the screen whose whole content IS the capability. Reads of history and removals stay open.

unregistered.DELETE /merchant/stores/:storeSlug/marke: REMOVAL — taking something away must never be blocked by an availability switch; a merchant or customer can always undo.
unregistered.POST /merchant/stores/:storeSlug/pos/dev: SECURITY — revoking access is a safety action; it must work while the capability is closed.
unregistered.GET /merchant/stores/:storeSlug/pos/shor: READ OF HISTORY — what already happened stays visible when the capability closes; the gate sits on the action that creates new state. Shortfalls are the stock the POS already sold short.
unregistered.POST /merchant/stores/:storeSlug/pos/sho: RECONCILIATION — reviewing a shortfall settles stock the POS already sold; blocking it would leave inventory wrong for as long as the switch is off.
unregistered.GET /merchant/stores/:storeSlug/inventor: READ OF HISTORY — what already happened stays visible when the capability closes; the gate sits on the action that creates new state. Returns already physically received wait for inspection.
